_readme: Scholar corrections layered over dvaita_grantha_anukramani.json, which is
the raw import of the Excel bibliography and is never edited in place —
Written by dge/dvaita-grantha-anukramani/ : corrections are held in the
browser as a draft and committed here through the GitHub API when someone
presses Sync, so every change to the master data arrives as a reviewable diff.
canonical: per kind (category / author / title), a variant spelling -> the
spelling to show everywhere. One entry retires a misspelling
across every row that used it (भाष्यम -> भाष्यम्).
parents:   row id -> the row id that is really its parent, for the ~2,180
rows the sheet left unlinked. An empty string means 'reviewed,
genuinely has no parent', so the suggestion stops reappearing.
rows:      row id -> field overrides, labels and a note for that one row.
review:    row id -> retain | delete (duplicate decisions).
links:     row or master id -> a confirmed cross-corpus match (library.json
path, guru-parampara node id, author_aliases person id).
